summary.intent: Complete the CipherBox v2 wayfinder map's final blueprint ticket (deployment/infra/release), then use that blueprint to kick off the actual v1-freeze and v2 workspace scaffold in the cipher-box repo.
summary.outcome: Wayfinder map closed (blueprint/deploy.md merged, ticket #48 and map issue #1 closed); executed the v1 freeze (branch+tag at 07376d0b, release PR closed); shipped a large freeze-handover PR #616 (release automation retired, toolchain single-sourced, GSD artifacts removed, blueprint corpus adopted, AGENTS.md made source of truth, README rewritten, landing site converted npm→pnpm) which was merged after fixing stale required-status-check entries; began v2 workspace scaffold (v1 code removed, Rust workspace stubs + TS workspace stubs created and verified green, ci.yml rewritten as day-one v2 gate) with commits made but PR not yet opened.

repo: cipher-box uses 1Password SSH commit signing (gpg.format=ssh) which intermittently hangs; standing rule is to timeout-guard signed commits and retry, never use --no-gpg-sign without explicit user authorization
zsh aborts an entire compound command if any glob in it fails to match (e.g. `rm ... gsd-*.json` with no matches kills the whole rm)
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL deprecation; use `gh api -X PATCH .../pulls/N -F body=@file` instead
GitHub branch protection can hold 'expected — waiting for status update' checks forever if the producing workflow file is deleted; must manually remove those required-status-check entries
ruby's YAML.load (not unsafe_load_file, no aliases) is a working fallback for validating workflow YAML when python lacks the yaml module

landing/ (Astro site) was actually npm-managed (own package-lock.json) despite being described as part of the pnpm workspace; needed `--ignore-workspace` when importing its lockfile with pnpm since it isn't a pnpm-workspace member
cipher-box-next's pattern: CLAUDE.md just contains `@AGENTS.md`, with AGENTS.md as the harness-agnostic source of truth — now mirrored in cipher-box

code.finding: Rewritten to workflow_dispatch-only with a dormancy header comment during the v2 freeze; single-component config (release-as 2.0.0, manifest 1.0.0) replaces the old 16-component per-package release matrix

Restructured as the day-one v2 PR gate (Lint/Typecheck/Test/Build/Cargo x3); dropped api-spec, sdk-e2e, migration-check, and vector-parity jobs since those v1 systems (openapi codegen, sdk-e2e suite, typeorm migrations, crypto vector parity) no longer exist in v2 scaffold

Bootstrap config for dormant single-component release-please: root package release-as pinned to 2.0.0 against manifest 1.0.0, satisfying the 'never leave release-as equal to manifest version' rule from the old CLAUDE.md

workflow: Long-running inventory/research work (e.g. full CI/CD infra audit) is well-suited to a background Agent call whose result is consumed once, rather than doing it inline
When a user vetoes a deletion ('X could be adapted rather than nuked'), recover original content via `git show HEAD~1:<path>` and adapt in place rather than reconstructing from memory

Watching PR CI to completion in the background (`gh pr checks --watch`) combined with querying review threads via GraphQL is the pattern used to confirm a PR is truly mergeable before reporting back to the user
Task/TaskCreate used to track a multi-step scaffold (v1 removal, Cargo workspace, TS workspace, CI rewrite, verify+ship) so long solo work stays organized without a subagent

friction: 1Password SSH signing hung repeatedly on cipher-box-next, requiring multiple background retries with increasing timeouts before the user authorized an unsigned commit

Stale GitHub branch-protection required status checks ('Release Preview', 'Verify E2E Passed') blocked PR #616 from merging even though all real CI was green, requiring manual protection-rule editing to diagnose and fix
Write tool repeatedly failed with 'File has not been read yet' on files not previously Read in this session, requiring extra Read calls before edits
zsh glob-abort silently killed a batch rm command, requiring a second pass to catch the leftover file
python coderabbit-config edit failed via naive substring match because the target block was the last entry with no trailing anchor line
Injected a duplicate `name:` line into deploy-staging.yml due to a wrong assumption about the workflow's existing name field, caught and fixed immediately
open_items: PR #616 successor (v2 workspace scaffold branch) has commits but no PR opened yet; still pending: full local verify, PR creation (draft→ready, no attribution), CI green, and updating main's required status checks to the new v2 job set before merge
After scaffold PR merges: seed the GitHub-issues v2 milestone build tracker, one issue per PR-sized slice from blueprint docs, begin build in dependency order starting with crates/core

Repo-local .claude/ GSD hooks/agents/commands fully removed except crypto-privacy-reviewer, resolve-pr-reviews, statusline, frontend-design plugin, and the adapted /ship command — confirmed intentional, not an open item but worth noting for future sessions expecting GSD tooling
v1 code (apps, packages, crates, tests) deleted from cipher-box main per deploy.md disposition tables; full history preserved on the `v1` branch/tag if anything needs recovery
